summary.text: Joel Stetkis is the Republican candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
He served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2014 to 2022 and was elected chairman of the Maine Republican Party in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Joel Stetkis represented District 105 in the Maine House of Representatives, assuming office on December 2, 2014, and left office on December 6, 2022.

In the 2019-2020 session he was assigned to the Joint Rules, Elections, and Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business committees, and in 2021-2022 to the Rules and Business of the House Committee.
He was a delegate from Maine to the 2016 Republican National Convention.
On January 28, 2023, he was elected to serve as chairman of the Maine Republican Party.
